patterns.note: Sections alternate between dark and light backgrounds, often with full-width content areas and generous vertical padding, creating clear visual breaks.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established with very large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings for dramatic impact, contrasted with smaller, lighter sans-serif for body text and functional labels.
A high-contrast palette of black, white, and light gray is consistently accented by a vibrant, almost neon, lime green used sparingly for CTAs, highlights, and interactive elements.

Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience. A persistent, subtle grid pattern in the background moves with a parallax effect.

The initial hero section transitions into a prominent form, followed by distinct sections for team/speaker profiles, a detailed schedule, and an FAQ, each clearly delineated by background color and spacing.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger, are employed to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.
A persistent, subtle grid pattern is overlaid on the background, which moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax depth effect.
The main navigation bar transforms from an initial state within the hero into a compact, sticky header with a solid background and a prominent CTA button once the user scrolls past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold, uppercase headings (~4-5x body text) for dramatic impact, with body text and labels in a clear, legible sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in hero and section breaks, creating a sense of openness and allowing content to breathe.

standout: The distinctive use of a vibrant lime green as the sole accent color against a stark black and white palette, combined with a persistent, subtly animated grid background and oversized, bold typography, gives the site a high-tech, energetic, and modern aesthetic. The site's ability to convey a 'hackathon' vibe through its visual language is particularly strong.
